verdicts.reason: Both use the same text column, with a big dead gap between the Shop Sale CTA and the legal line and an undersized shoe pushed to the right edge. A pulls the peach circle down into the canvas, losing the original's top-right bleed, and its shoe sits awkwardly on the circle's bottom edge, below the CTA row. B keeps the circle bleeding off the top like the original and lifts the shoe closer to the CTA row, but its shoe still crowds the right edge and the lower third is empty.
